concept.material: molded dark green resin and brass wire
concept.internal_detail: fine brass cogs and micro-piston linkages
concept.button: a flat brass disk set flush into the resin back
concept.shell_mechanic: The resin monocoque splits cleanly down the middle and hinges open outward like two heavy doors
concept.emerging_parts: Four short digging limbs with steel claws and a blunt snout
concept.signature_move: its tiny amber glass eyes light up and its front digging claws lift together on their hinges and drop back down in a single clockwork step
